STEP 1 - Vessel type: Square flat plate. It has a rim band and a flat centre with no inner wall or shadow.

STEP 2 - Vessel size: The two corn rounds are about 4.5 cm across, and they span roughly 22% of the plate's width. That puts the plate at about 20-22 cm square. Taking 22 cm as the width (484 cm²).

STEP 3 - Food items:
- Kale salad with dressing: covers about 25% of the plate, about 120 cm². Loose, dressed leaves average about 1.5 cm thick, so about 180 ml. At about 0.3 g/ml (dressed greens) that is about 55-60 g. Kcal about 100 per 100 g, so about 60 kcal.
- Parmesan shavings: about 2-3 small pieces, about 5 g, about 390 kcal per 100 g, so about 20 kcal.
- Crumb-topped fish or chicken piece on the left: about 8 x 5 cm footprint (40 cm²) by about 2 cm thick, so about 80 ml at 1.0 g/ml gives about 80 g. Kcal about 160 per 100 g for a breaded, cheesy piece, so about 130 kcal.
- Two corn rounds: each about 4.5 cm across and 3 cm thick, so about 48 ml each. At 0.6 g/ml, that is about 29 g each, about 58 g total. Kcal about 96 per 100 g, so about 56 kcal.

STEP 4 - Hidden food: No base layer is visible under the salad or the fish piece beyond what is counted. No extra items added.

STEP 5 - Total: about 200 g and about 265 kcal. The fish piece is the least certain item, since its composition is hard to see.
